description: Web (Next.js): en apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/payments/page.tsx permitir adjuntar hasta 3 imágenes de respaldo al registrar un pago (selector de archivo) y mostrar thumbnails con URL firmada en la lista de pagos, bajo el flag payment_photo_evidence; con un helper nuevo apps/web/src/lib/payment-evidence.ts. Depende de FEAT-001 (bucket, tabla, flag, constantes @fundo360/shared). Independiente de FEAT-002 (mobile).
steps: Crear apps/web/src/lib/payment-evidence.ts: importar { PAYMENT_EVIDENCE } de '@fundo360/shared' y createClient de '@/lib/supabase'. Implementar currentOrgId(): leer org_id del claim del JWT (await supabase.auth.getSession(); decodificar el payload base64url del access_token; devolver json.org_id o null) — equivalente al currentOrgId() de apps/mobile/src/lib/picking-evidence.ts pero usando atob del navegador. evidencePath(orgId, paymentId, uuid)=>`${orgId}/${paymentId}/${uuid}.<ext>`. uploadPaymentEvidence({orgId, paymentId, file}): derivar ext del file.type (jpeg/png/webp), generar uuid con crypto.randomUUID(), supabase.storage.from(PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.BUCKET).upload(path, file, {upsert:false, contentType:file.type}); devolver path. signedPaymentEvidenceUrl(path, 3600) con createSignedUrl.

En apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/payments/page.tsx importar { useFeatureFlag } from '@/hooks/useFeatureFlag', { PAYMENT_EVIDENCE } from '@fundo360/shared', el helper de '@/lib/payment-evidence', y un icono de 'lucide-react' (p. ej. ImagePlus / X) para la UI de adjuntar/quitar.

En CreatePaymentForm: const { enabled: photoEnabled } = useFeatureFlag('payment_photo_evidence'); const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]). Añadir, SOLO si photoEnabled, un bloque 'Fotos de respaldo (opcional, máx 3)' con <input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" multiple onChange=...> que acumula en files hasta PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.MAX_IMAGES (deshabilitar el input/botón al llegar al máx) y muestra miniaturas (URL.createObjectURL) con botón 'Quitar'. Usar tokens HSL del tema (text-foreground, bg-muted/30, border-border, ring-primary/30) ya presentes en el archivo; nada hardcodeado fuera de tokens.

En handleSubmit de CreatePaymentForm: cambiar el insert del pago a const { data: inserted, error: dbError } = await supabase.from('payments').insert({...}).select('id').single(); mantener EXACTAMENTE el update de status del settlement actual (no tocar pending/partial/paid ni la inmutabilidad del settlement pagado). Tras un pago exitoso y si photoEnabled && files.length>0: orgId=await currentOrgId(); obtener el worker.id del usuario actual para uploaded_by (resolver vía el claim/sesión como ya hace la app para otras escrituras — si no hay un helper, leerlo de la fila workers del usuario actual; mantener consistencia con cómo el proyecto obtiene el worker actual en web). Por cada file: uploadPaymentEvidence({orgId, paymentId: inserted.id, file}) y supabase.from('payment_photo_evidence').insert({ payment_id: inserted.id, image_path: path, uploaded_by: <worker.id> }). Secuencia best-effort: el pago es crítico (ya hecho); si una foto falla, toast 'El pago se registró; una foto no se pudo adjuntar' y continuar.

En la lista de pagos (columnas de la DataTable o una celda nueva): cuando photoEnabled, resolver y mostrar thumbnails de la evidencia de cada pago. Opción recomendada: ampliar el useQuery de ['payments'] para traer también payment_photo_evidence por payment_id (segunda consulta .in('payment_id', ids) agrupada por payment_id), y en una columna 'Fotos' renderizar miniaturas usando signedPaymentEvidenceUrl(image_path, 3600); click abre la imagen en grande (modal o nueva pestaña). Mantener el patrón de columnas/estilos existente.
Invalidar queries de ['payments'] en onSuccess (ya ocurre) para refrescar los thumbnails tras adjuntar.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` (desde la raíz del worktree) pasa sin errores (next build + typecheck de apps/web) con los cambios.
Con el flag OFF (sin override), el bloque de adjuntar NO aparece y el registro de pago funciona como hoy.

Con el flag ON (override org), se adjuntan hasta 3 imágenes (input se deshabilita en 3), se crean filas en payment_photo_evidence tras el pago, y los thumbnails con URL firmada se muestran en la lista.
La UI usa tokens HSL del tema e iconos lucide-react; sin colores hardcodeados fuera de tokens.
No se modifica la lógica de status del settlement.
verification: npm run build  (desde la raíz del worktree; next build + typecheck de apps/web deben pasar)

Verificación visual (si hay entorno Supabase/web local): con el override del flag ON, registrar un pago con 2 imágenes y confirmar thumbnails en la lista; con el flag OFF, el bloque no aparece. Si no hay entorno, registrar en findings que se validó por inspección del gating + build verde.
findings:
COMPLETED.

NEW HELPER apps/web/src/lib/payment-evidence.ts (web counterpart of apps/mobile/src/lib/picking-evidence.ts): imports PAYMENT_EVIDENCE from @fundo360/shared, BUCKET = PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.BUCKET ('payment-evidence'). Exports: currentOrgId() -> reads org_id from the JWT access_token claim using the browser's atob (base64url -> base64 -> JSON.parse), returns org_id string or null (no session / no claim); evidencePath(orgId, paymentId, uuid, ext) => `${orgId}/${paymentId}/${uuid}.${ext}`; uploadPaymentEvidence({orgId, paymentId, file}) -> derives ext from file.type (jpeg->jpg, png->png, webp->webp, fallback jpg), generates uuid via crypto.randomUUID(), supabase.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(path, file, {upsert:false, contentType:file.type}), returns path; signedPaymentEvidenceUrl(path, 3600) via createSignedUrl. Each exported fn calls createClient() from '@/lib/supabase' locally (web client is request-scoped, unlike mobile's singleton).

WIRING apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/payments/page.tsx:
- Imports added: PAYMENT_EVIDENCE (@fundo360/shared), useFeatureFlag ('@/hooks/useFeatureFlag'), currentOrgId+uploadPaymentEvidence+signedPaymentEvidenceUrl ('@/lib/payment-evidence'), ImagePlus+X (lucide-react), useEffect.
- PaymentsPage: const { enabled: photoEnabled } = useFeatureFlag('payment_photo_evidence'). Added a second useQuery ['payment-evidence', paymentIds] (enabled only when photoEnabled && there are payment ids) that selects payment_id,image_path from payment_photo_evidence .in('payment_id', ids) and groups into Record<payment_id, image_path[]>. A 'Fotos' column is appended to the DataTable columns ONLY when photoEnabled; it renders <PaymentEvidenceThumbnails paths={...}>.
- PaymentEvidenceThumbnails (new module-level component): resolves signedPaymentEvidenceUrl(path, 3600) for each path in a useEffect (guarded against unmount), renders 9x9 thumbnails as buttons; click opens the signed URL in a new tab. Shows '—' when no evidence.
- CreatePaymentForm now receives photoEnabled prop; state const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]). When photoEnabled, a 'Fotos de respaldo (opcional, máx 3)' block renders: object-URL thumbnails with a per-photo 'Quitar' (X icon) button, plus an 'Agregar foto' <label>+hidden <input type=file accept=image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp multiple>. addFiles accumulates and slices to PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.MAX_IMAGES; input is disabled and the label dimmed (pointer-events-none opacity-50) at the max.
- handleSubmit: the payment insert now ends with .select('id').single() to obtain inserted.id. The settlement status update (newPaid >= total_amount ? 'paid' : 'partial') is BYTE-FOR-BYTE unchanged. After a successful payment, if photoEnabled && files.length>0 && inserted.id: orgId = await currentOrgId(); the current worker id is resolved via supabase.auth.getUser() + workers.select('id').eq('auth_user_id', user.id).maybeSingle() (same pattern used in apps/web/.../records/page.tsx). For each file: uploadPaymentEvidence then insert into payment_photo_evidence { payment_id, image_path, uploaded_by: me.id }. Best-effort: every photo is wrapped in try/catch and the insert error is checked; any failure (including missing orgId/worker) only raises a toast 'El pago se registró; una foto no se pudo adjuntar' and NEVER reverts the payment.
- onSuccess invalidates ['payments'] (as before) plus ['payment-evidence'] so thumbnails refresh after attaching.
- Styling uses existing HSL theme tokens (text-foreground, bg-muted/30, border-border, ring-primary/30, text-muted-foreground, bg-primary) and lucide-react icons; no hardcoded colors outside the pre-existing palette classes already present in the file.

NOT TOUCHED: settlement status logic / prevent_paid_settlement_update immutability; payments.amount and all calculations; no Edge Functions created or modified (evidence follows the client-direct model: Storage upload + SDK insert, RLS is the security layer).

VERIFICATION:
- `npm run build` from the worktree root -> PASS (exit 0). Turbo runs @fundo360/web:build = next build 15.5.23: 'Compiled successfully', 'Checking validity of types' passed, 21/21 static pages generated; /payments route built (6.51 kB). (Mobile has no build script so turbo build only runs web, same as FEAT-002.) Worktree-local node_modules/@fundo360/shared resolves to this worktree's packages/shared (verified), so PAYMENT_EVIDENCE resolved correctly.
- Visual check NOT run: no local Supabase/web dev environment up here (per context.json: Rancher Desktop not in dockerd/moby). Validated by inspection of the gating + green typed build: flag OFF -> useFeatureFlag returns false, so neither the attach block nor the 'Fotos' column render and the payment path is byte-identical to before; flag ON (org override) -> attach block appears, input disables at 3, evidence rows inserted best-effort, thumbnails resolved via signed URL in the list. Suggested manual check once web+Supabase run locally: toggle payment_photo_evidence org override ON, register a payment with 2 images, confirm 2 rows in payment_photo_evidence (uploaded_by=current worker) and thumbnails in the Fotos column; toggle OFF and confirm the block/column disappear and payment still works.
